svg.title: The factors of the sporadic groups: a 3-D flyover of prime-power towers
svg.text: The sporadic groups as a 3-D city of prime-power towers
flying over all 27 groups — one block per group, one tower per prime 2–71, tower height = the exponent in |G| = ∏ p^e
the Monster’s 2⁴⁶ is the tallest tower of all (Lean: monster_tallest_tower); every skyline reconstructs its |G| exactly (Lean: fromFactorList)
every prime-power tower p^e is a machine-checked factor of |G| · the whole skyline multiplies back to |G| exactly
